sentences.text: Sam y doña Marta están en la casa.
sentences.english: Sam and doña Marta are at the house.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Doña Marta, ¿puedo aprender a preparar baleadas?
sentences.english: Doña Marta, can I learn to prepare baleadas?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hoy preparamos baleadas para la familia.
sentences.english: Today we prepare baleadas for the family.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Nico tiene tos y la garganta mal, y necesita comer bien.
sentences.english: Nico has a cough and a bad throat, and he needs to eat well.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What does a good baleada need?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Tortilla de harina, frijoles, queso y crema.
sentences.english: A flour tortilla, beans, cheese and cream.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Primero vamos a la pulpería, y después hacemos la receta.
sentences.english: First we go to the shop, and afterwards we follow the recipe.

sentences.text: Doña Marta y Sam caminan a la pulpería.
sentences.english: Doña Marta and Sam walk to the shop.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: I need everything for the baleadas.

sentences.text: Sam paga y la señora da una bolsa grande a doña Marta.
sentences.english: Sam pays and the woman gives a big bag to doña Marta.

sentences.text: Doña Marta lleva la bolsa a la casa.
sentences.english: Doña Marta carries the bag to the house.

sentences.text: Sam escribe la receta en su libro.
sentences.english: Sam writes the recipe in his book.

sentences.text: Se necesita: harina, sal, aceite, agua, frijoles, queso, crema, tomate y cebolla.
sentences.english: You need: flour, salt, oil, water, beans, cheese, cream, tomato and onion.

sentences.text: Primero se pone la harina en un plato.
sentences.english: First, the flour is put in a plate.

sentences.text: Luego se agrega una cuchara de sal y dos cucharas de aceite.
sentences.english: Then one spoon of salt and two spoons of oil are added.

sentences.text: Después se agrega agua, y se hacen las tortillas con las manos.
sentences.english: Afterwards water is added, and the tortillas are made by hand.

sentences.text: Se fríe la tortilla por un momento.
sentences.english: The tortilla is fried for a moment.

sentences.text: Mientras se fríe la tortilla, se calientan los frijoles.
sentences.english: While the tortilla fries, the beans are heated.

sentences.text: Se corta el tomate y se corta la cebolla.
sentences.english: The tomato is cut and the onion is cut.

sentences.text: Se pone la tortilla en un plato.
sentences.english: The tortilla is put on a plate.

sentences.text: Se agrega el frijol, el queso y la crema.
sentences.english: The beans, the cheese and the cream are added.

sentences.text: Por último, se pone la verdura.
sentences.english: Last, the vegetables are put on top.

sentences.text: Ahora Sam prepara una baleada solo.
sentences.english: Now Sam prepares a baleada alone.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Doña Marta, how many do I need?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Dos tomates y una cebolla pequeña.
sentences.english: Two tomatoes and one small onion.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: First I take a big spoon.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hay que freír la tortilla un momento.
sentences.english: You have to fry the tortilla for a moment.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Es mejor para el cuerpo y para la salud.
sentences.english: It is better for the body and for health.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Con el tiempo, todo es fácil.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Aprendí con mi mamá en el pueblo.
sentences.english: I learned with my mother in the village.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Ella cocinó para toda la gente.
Nico llega con la mochila y su juego.
sentences.english: Nico arrives with his school bag and his game.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El doctor dijo que es una enfermedad pequeña.
sentences.english: The doctor said it is a small illness.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Sí, tomé la pastilla en la mañana.
sentences.english: Yes, I took the pill in the morning.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Tu cita con el doctor es el lunes.
sentences.english: Your appointment with the doctor is on Monday.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: You must take care of your body.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Ayer tuviste sangre en la nariz, pero ya estás mejor.
sentences.english: Yesterday you had blood in your nose, but you are better now.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: La verdura es buena para el cuerpo.
sentences.english: Vegetables are good for the body.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Una baleada así es buena para la salud.
sentences.english: A baleada like this is good for your health.

sentences.text: Ana y Luis llegan a la casa.
sentences.english: Ana and Luis arrive at the house.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Ahora tenés que cocinar todos los sábados.
sentences.english: Now you have to cook every Saturday.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: I want to learn too, grandmother.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: First you have to get better.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Es la receta de doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Voy a escribir la receta para el equipo.
sentences.english: I am going to write the recipe for the team.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: El fin de semana vamos a hacer baleadas en el parque.
sentences.english: This weekend we are going to make baleadas in the park.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Es posible hacer baleadas para toda la gente?
sentences.english: Is it possible to make baleadas for all the people?

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Solo se necesita más tiempo y más ayuda.
sentences.english: You just need more time and more help.

sentences.text: Después del paseo, todos comen y dan gracias a Dios.
sentences.english: After the outing, everyone eats and gives thanks to God.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Thank you, doña Marta, for everything.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.english: Grandmother, tomorrow I want baleadas too.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.english: Now you are part of the family.
